item.title: Comiket Survival Guide: How to Visit Comic Market as an Overseas Fan
item.description: Every year, twice a year, the attention of the anime and manga world swings to a cluster of futuristic buildings on the waterfront of Tokyo Bay. Over three days, more than 700,000 fans pour into Tokyo Big Sight for Comiket — the world’s largest self-published media fair, where over 30,000 independent creator groups (circles) sell their own original comics, art books, games, and music directly to buyers. If Akihabara is anime culture’s permanent home, Comiket is its beating heart.
